content: These past few screw holes have been the worst. Were these designed by the intern?
Yep, holes were quite tight, definitely another place that an M3 tap comes in handy (though even that struggled to start at first without some extra force)
+1 for pre-threading. The holes killed my small electric screwdriver. Ended up pulling out my Dewalt to pre-thread

replies.content: Glad I'm not the only one. My wrists are too wrecked at this point to do the prethreading by hand.

content: Holes my the hinges were pretty tight, recommend pre-threading before attaching these.
